text: ON&ON Herbal Toothpaste (150g) MRP
Product Description:

The toothpaste contains natural extracts of neem, clove & babul which provide strong antibacterial and antifungal properties. This helps in control of plaque and tartar build up, thereby making the gum & teeth healthy and strong, thus reducing the incidence of cavity and tooth decay. Regular use of the product will ensure complete oral hygiene.
Net Content: 150g

Directions for use: Use ON&ON Herbal Toothpaste daily by applying a pea-sized amount to your toothbrush. Brush thoroughly, ensuring coverage of teeth and gums. Rinse thoroughly with water. For best results, use twice daily as part of your regular oral care regimen to maintain strong, healthy teeth and gums naturally.

Ingredients: Neem (Azadirachta indica)-0.10%, Babool (Acacia Arabica)-0.10%, Mulethi (Glycyrrhiza glabra)-0.10%, Laung oil (Syzygium aromaticum)-0.20%, Akarkara (Anacyclus pyrethrum)-0.10%, Pippali (Piper longum)-0.10%, Vajradanti (Barleria prionitis)-0.10%, Vidang (Embelia ribes)-0.10%, Haldi (Curcuma longa)-0.10%, Pilu (Salvadora persica) 0.10%, Menthol crystal (Mentha spicata)-0.5%, Sorbitol, PEG 400, Sodium CMC, Calcium Carbonate , Hydrated Silica, Sodium Saccharin, Sodium lauryl sulphate, Sodium Benzoate, Purified water.
Storage: Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Keep out of reach of children.
Manufactured by: Skyline Herbals Private Limited , No. 10, Mahagujarat Estate, Moraiya, Dist. Ahmedabad -382213. Mfg Lic No Gc/1474
Marketed by: Mi Lifestyle Marketing Global Private Limited. No.25, G.N.Chetty Road, T. Nagar, Chennai-600017, Tamil Nadu.
Shelf Life:Use before 24 months from the date of manufacture

Additional Information: Neem toothpaste offers multiple benefits including fighting tooth decay, teeth whitening, freshening breath, removing plaque, and tartar Its blend of herbal ingredients ensures a gentle yet effective oral care routine, maintaining optimal dental health without harsh chemicals. Ideal for those seeking natural solutions for oral hygiene with proven antibacterial properties.Used for: Fighting tooth decay, whitening teeth, freshening breath, removing plaque and tartar.Benefits: Fights tooth decay. Safely whitens teeth. Freshens breath. Removes plaque. Maintains optimal dental health without harsh chemicals
